modules.module_title: Taking charge of shift from Printing machine operator

pcs.pc_description: come at least 10 - 15 minutes earlier to the work place
bring the necessary operational tools to the department

meet the previous shift Printing machine operator and discuss with him/ her regarding the issues faced by them with respect to the quality ,production, spare safety or any other specific instruction etc.
understand the fabric being processed & process running on the machine
ensure the technical details are mentioned on the job card display on the machine
check for the availability of the spare trolley for unloading the fabric
check the next batch to be processed is ready near the machine
ensure the required dyes & chemicals are already weighed & prepared
check the cleanliness of the machines & other work areas
question the previous shift operator for any deviation in the above and should bring the same to the knowledge of his/ her shift superior as well as that of the previous shift.
take over the shift from the outgoing operator in a proper manner

modules.module_title: Handing over shift to Printing machine operator

pcs.pc_description: ensure in providing the details regarding fabric quality & the process running on the machine
provide all relevant information regarding the stoppages or breakdown in the machine, any damage to the fabric or machine.
ensure the empty trolley is near the machine for unloading the fabric
ensure the next lot to be processed is ready near the machine already stitched & arranged properly
ensure the required dyes & chemicals for the next lot or next process are weighed & prepared
get clearance from the incoming counterpart before leaving the work spot
report to his/ her shift superiors as well as that of the incoming shift operator in case his/ her counterpart doesn't report for the incoming shift
ensure the shift has to be properly handed over to the incoming shift operator

report to his/ her shift superior about the quality / production / safety issues/ any other issue faced in his/ her shift and leave the department only after getting concurrence for the same from his/ her superiors
collect the wastes from waste collection bags, weigh them and transport to storage area
ensure the machine and its work place is clean

modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory activities for operations in the machine

pcs.pc_description: understand the task mentioned in the work order
ensure that the machine is empty & clean
load the fabric from the batch/trolley in the center of the machine at the feeding point
ensure fabric is crease-free and lint/ dust free
place the screens on the print station/ printing head according to the colours to be printed
set the repeat according to the design to be printed
apply glue /adhesive material to the printing blanket for sticking
get all dyes & printing chemical / auxiliaries weighed
mix the thickener, binder & other auxiliaries first to get the required viscosity
add dyes/ pigments to the thickening paste according to the shade
filter the print paste to avoid choke up of design screen

modules.module_title: Operate the machine for specified tasks as per work order

pcs.pc_description: check screen zero position on the blanket for proper fabric printing before starting to print fabric
Start the machine &adjust the squeeze pressure if registration is poor or uneven
adjust the squeeze pressure if registration is poor or uneven
maintain synchronized & continuous feeding of fabric
check for pin holes & other defects due to blockage of screen
clean the screens if machine is stopped for longer periods

modules.module_title: Clean the machine on a regular basis and carryout preventive maintenance activities

pcs.pc_description: make sure the fabric is dried properly after printing
keep the machine clean at all times
follow the preventive maintenance schedule & ensure the machine is running smoothly
check that all controls are functioning properly
clean the printing blanket before changing to new design or new matching
cut the sample after the dryer
fix/ cure the printed sample in a steamer or oven
wash the sample after curing & dry it

modules.module_title: Checking the sample with the standard

pcs.pc_description: compare the sample with standard as mentioned in the work order
take the sample to supervisor if its not matching to standard

modules.module_title: Carry out preparatory activities for screen making

pcs.pc_description: understand the task mentioned in the work order
check the art work or the design film to be exposed
check the design repeat
check the no. of colours to be printed
clean the screen frames
select the right mesh size depending upon the design to be printed
cut the required no. of mesh fabric as per size of screen

modules.module_title: Operate the machine for the specified task as per work order

pcs.pc_description: stretch the mesh on all frames evenly & leave it for few hours
re stretch the mesh again & stick it to the frame with glue
degrease the screen thoroughly using screen degreaser
apply solvent resistant direct emulsion evenly to the screen
dry the screen completely before exposure
maintain optimum drying conditions in the drying area
ensure the drying area is warm & dust free
expose the screen using a light exposure unit
wash the exposed screen thoroughly
dry the screen completely

modules.module_title: Clean the machine on a regular basis and carryout preventive maintenance activities

follow the preventive maintenance schedule & ensure the machine is running smoothly
check that all controls are functioning properly
replace the exposing unit bulbs when its due
keep the exposing & drying area dust free
store the screen in the rack for repeat orders

modules.module_title: Checking the quality of exposed design screen

pcs.pc_description: examine the screen under white light for pinhole & other defects
do the touching of any pin holes or other defects
mask the sides with tape to avoid wastage of print paste
fix the end rings to the screen in case of Rotary screen
